name: Jiangsu Lixing General Steel Ball Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Lixing General Steel Ball Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of precision bearing rolling elements in China and internationally. It offers specialized steel balls for hub bearing units of cars; precision noiseless small and micro steel balls; large precision heavy-duty bearing steel balls; high-precision ceramic balls; high-precision tapered and cylindrical rollers; and ball screw. The company's products are used in automobiles, precision electrical appliances, large wind turbines, rail transportation, aerospace, and other fields. It exports its products.
